target: Post-1.0.7 / 1.0.8 framework; February 2012 consequence semantics; incomplete original formulas

rules.name: Roster role cap
rules.decision: Three per role across ten players; inactive old templates are editable but not playable until legal.

rules.name: Five field players
rules.decision: Five owned players; role caps apply.

rules.name: One team special
rules.decision: Client last assignment wins; malformed submitted double specials are rejected.

rules.name: Caster replaces ordinary turn
rules.decision: Caster cannot combine ordinary assignments with a special.

rules.name: Reserve recovery
rules.decision: Living reserves heal; field players retain HP; dead reserves stay dead pending revival evidence.

rules.name: Water movement reliability
rules.decision: One seeded draw at turn start; nonzero green risk and Water dependence use explicit replacement balance.

rules.name: Water required to stand
rules.decision: Down players need Water; existing stand-up delay/resource budget retained.

rules.name: Targeted combat consequences
rules.decision: Official consequence rows; existing deterministic score proxy and configurable threshold equality are unverified.

rules.name: Incidental zero-damage stun
rules.decision: Normal incidental/dodge win stuns for zero HP damage; four-damage critical dodge down is a separate flag.

rules.name: Pickup crowd pressure
rules.decision: Both teams count as pressure; radius and penalty are configurable replacement values.

rules.name: Pickup prior combat losses
rules.decision: Each same-turn loss contributes a configurable pickup penalty; bookkeeping resets with the turn world.

rules.name: Separate throw and catch
rules.decision: Separate throw/catch tests; failed tests scatter to a seeded point on the trajectory (replacement distribution).

rules.name: Preassigned pass chains
rules.decision: Onward assignments survive until possession; flights chain; Air speeds travel using a configurable replacement coefficient.

rules.name: Arrival deadline
rules.decision: Arrival must be before the discrete turn end.

rules.name: Contact interrupts throw
rules.decision: Contact cancels an unlaunched carrier pass; converging trajectories may defer launch under an explicit timing heuristic.

rules.name: Path interception
rules.decision: Path/height/radius samples plus a forward flight-segment filter; exact historical corridor and retries remain provisional.

rules.name: Mid-turn stun recovery
rules.decision: Water-based configurable stun duration allows a receiver to recover before ball arrival.

rules.name: Ecaflip healing redirection
rules.decision: Only opposing Eniripsa healing is redirected; no opponent heal means no effect.

rules.name: No five-score cutoff
rules.decision: Continue to the stadium turn limit; fifth score is not a cutoff.

rules.name: Historical tournament format
rules.decision: Keep the user-requested Saturday Paris qualifying/bracket competition.

rules.name: Late tournament settlement
rules.decision: Keep custom bracket settlement; historical timed-event accounting not claimed.

rules.name: Reconnect grace
rules.decision: Two-minute grace after heartbeat loss detection; clocks continue; boundary and both-offline policy are explicit.
